entries.ea9b5237ba878a72: As the effective free tuition for private high schools expands and fewer students aim for Tokyo Metropolitan junior and senior high schools, which had been its strength, a direction can be read from this: shifting the focus of its preparation to private school entrance exams and expanding campus locations to neighboring prefectures in the Tokyo metropolitan area to respond to changes in demand.
entries.eebac31ce0deca57: In March 2025, the company formulated a medium-term management plan covering three years through the fiscal year ending March 2028. In addition to its traditional preparation for Tokyo Metropolitan junior high and senior high school entrance exams, it will fully commit to preparation for private junior high and private senior high school entrance exams, shifting from “ena for Tokyo Metropolitan schools” to “ena for passing both Tokyo Metropolitan and private school exams.” Drawing on the teaching know-how accumulated through campus-based classes in Tokyo, it also plans to fully expand campus-based classes in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. It will also build an integrated guidance system across elementary, junior high and senior high school, including a tuition-free system for students who fail the Tokyo Metropolitan junior high school exam and continuing benefits for graduates.
